_key.title: Document Key
_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl gene ID and source file accession joined by underscores.

effect_size.title: Effect Size
effect_size.description: Estimated fractional change in gene expression for the effect allele relative to the other allele. Positive values indicate increased expression, negative values indicate decreased expression, and 0 indicates no change.

log2FC.title: Log2 Fold Change
log2FC.description: log2 fold-change in gene expression for the effect allele relative to the other allele.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.title: Adjusted Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Adjusted negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

power.title: Power
power.description: Power to detect an effect of the size observed, from 0 to 1.

posterior_inclusion_probability.title: Posterior Inclusion Probability
posterior_inclusion_probability.description: Posterior inclusion probability: the probability that the variant is in the causal set for the gene expression phenotype. Values range from 0 to 1.

coefficient_stddev.title: Coefficient Standard Deviation
coefficient_stddev.description: Standard deviation of the effect size estimate.

significant.title: Significant
significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the variant effect on gene expression.
